text: Exact-first lookup can bind a raw source reference to the wrong numbered source object: tables "A""B" (logical A"B) and "A""""B" (logical A""B) together; the reference "A""B" exact-matches the second.

Fixed by the conductor's D4 decision: the four lookups take a NameRef (Raw is unescaped exactly once, Logical is used as is), and each caller states its provenance (Design step 4, caller table). A raw reference is never matched before it is unescaped. Pinned by T6 (both tables declared, each reference binds its own table) with two breaks. Round 2 (sol re-raise = opus O9): T6 now adds a Logical guard (direct Logical lookup + implicit-Rec op in table 50111) whose Logical-arm break fails (ledger L141).
